system.unlock: Upgrade/specialty quest available from character level 10 (metabot); recommended at 45
system.proficiency: Mastery 1-100 per profession: Novice 1-50 (8,809 XP total), Professional 51-100 (82,680 more XP). At 50 take upgrade quest + craft test item (Blacksmithing: Novice Blacksmith's Hammer = 6 Orichalcum Ingot + 3 Odyle); reward item lifts cap to 100. Each recipe has a required proficiency; bigger gap gives higher success chance (secondary summary). XP-per-craft formula: not stated.
system.recipe_structure: Direct components + intermediate crafts (Artisan's/Expert's/Splendent tiers) expanding to base materials. 'Splendent' variant is a ~25% proc on crafting the base item (aion2hub note on helm). Mastery level per recipe not exposed in extracted pages (aion2kina calculator shows Lv 30-95 for Blacksmithing greatswords).
system.conflicts: aion2kina.com guide claims 300 skill levels, level-200 specialization, 4 crafting professions; contradicts metabot/wikily/aion2hub (100 levels, 5 professions). Treated as unreliable/Aion-1 style.

item_level_info: Crafted Dragon Lord gear spans IL 62-102 in tiers 62,70,78,86,94,102 (metabot). Mapping tier->specific item not extracted; per-recipe item_level null.
